FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Here's what some of our customers needed to know before signing up What is a unified inbox and why do I need one? A unified inbox is a centralized messaging hub that consolidates guest and owner communication from Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, email, SMS, and WhatsApp into a single interface. Property managers need one because juggling separate inboxes across multiple platforms burns hours and creates missed opportunities. Guesty's Unified Inbox displays every conversation in one dashboard with color-coded status indicators, filterable by urgency, reservation status, or check-in date. You can respond through any channel — OTA messaging, email, WhatsApp, SMS — without logging into separate platforms. Does the Unified Inbox use AI to answer guest messages? Yes. Guesty ReplyAI and AI Autopilot draft or auto-send on-brand replies to guest messages, using sentiment analysis to read intent and auto-translation to respond in the guest's language. AI Task Creation can also turn a guest message into an assignable task in one click. Which communication methods does the Unified Inbox support? The Unified Inbox consolidates your messages from your connected booking channels, such as your Airbnb inbox, Booking.com inbox, and more; email; SMS; and Whatsapp into one place. You can also respond to messages through any of these formats. Can you use a white-labeled domain name with the Unified Inbox? You will be given a default domain ending in @user.guesty.com, but you can replace it with a custom domain by sending Guesty a request that includes the white-labeled domain name. How does a unified inbox prevent missed guest messages? Picture this: a guest messages you on Airbnb at 2 AM asking about parking, then follows up via email at 8 AM because they haven't heard back. Without a unified inbox, you're checking both platforms separately — and the message sits unanswered for hours. A unified inbox prevents this by routing every conversation — Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, email, SMS, WhatsApp — into one dashboard. Try it now One view to rule them all: Guesty success stories MATT MARRS Texas | United States We've had zero double bookings since using Guesty and I think that ties directly to the Multi-Calendar. TIM MORTIMER Australia It's just at your fingertips — you can see which platforms properties are booked on and go from there. Less manual handling is a huge factor in reducing staff stress. BRANDRETH CANALEY Roami Florida | United States Double bookings in our combined units led to a lot of wasted time for our guest experience agents. Having the automated calendar rules prevents all of that. Guesty is trusted by property managers across the globe to manage 500K+ listings Get a demo FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Here's what some of our customers needed to know before signing up What is a Multi-Calendar and why I need one? A multi-calendar is a unified dashboard that displays availability, reservations, and operational details for all your properties in a single view. Property managers need one because managing properties across multiple platforms without central visibility creates chaos — you're constantly switching between tabs, missing vacancy gaps, and risking double bookings. Guesty's Multi-Calendar consolidates everything in real-time: confirmed reservations, blocks, cleaning status, pricing, and booking sources across Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, and all your other channels. You can filter by city, tag, or status, spot open dates instantly, and take action — send quotes, adjust rates, move guests between units — without leaving the calendar. It's the control center that turns scattered data into operational clarity. Will changes I make on the Multi-Calendar be reflected across my channels? Yes. When a change is made on Guesty's Multi-Calendar, those adjustments are automatically reflected across all channels that the user has synced with Guesty's platform Will all reservations and changes made within the channels be reflected in my calendar? Yes, the changes made within the channels will be reflected in your calendar. What changes can I make in the Multi-Calendar? Can I make reservations from within the calendar? You can make changes to the check-in or check-out time, meal plans, number of guests, number of nights, and more to specific reservations, as well as adjust pricing for unoccupied nights. You can also create new reservations and your actions will automatically sync across all connected booking channels. Can the Multi-Calendar be used for multi-unit properties? Yes. Guesty's calendar management software is compatible with multi-listing properties. Every location has its own vacation rental calendar, which displays all relevant information regarding each of its units. With Guesty's Smart Calendar Rules, you can create automated rules for multi-unit calendars, which are built to maximize occupancy by allowing you to move upcoming reservations from one unit to another. How does a Multi-Calendar prevent double bookings? A multi-calendar prevents double bookings by syncing availability across all channels in real-time the moment a reservation is confirmed. When a booking comes in on Airbnb at 2 AM, Guesty's Multi-Calendar instantly blocks those dates across Vrbo, Booking.com, and every other connected platform — no delays, no gaps, no manual updates. The system also features Smart Calendar Rules that automatically block linked properties when one is booked. This is critical for managing entire homes versus individual rooms, or adjoining suites — when someone books the master bedroom, the system can automatically block the entire house listing to prevent conflicts. jobs.description: Real-time status One-click sync Smooth scheduling Total management access Smart locks management for a stellar guest experience Connect 40+ smart lock brands and automate access for guests, staff, and vendors, all from Guesty's vacation rental software. Get Started Easily connect to over 40 major smart locks brands Access unlocked A single dashboard Our fully embedded solution lets you manage every lock from one dashboard, even if you use multiple locks providers. 5-star guest experience Prevent lockouts with secure access codes and backup options, ensuring seamless entry and smooth, stress-free check-in for your guests. Full visibility Get a full view of your locks activity. From usage data to remote monitoring to battery health, your locks data is at your fingertips. Your properties, full control From guest arrivals to maintenance crews, track and control who has access to your properties. 01 Booking Automate operations 02 Arrival Smooth check-in 03 In-stay Secure access 04 Checkout Peace of mind Code generation Automatically generate unique lock codes for all confirmed reservations with future check in dates, and when new reservations are confirmed. Every reservation, one code Guests receive one code that is valid for all locks, whether it’s the front door, apartment, or lounge, making it easy for guests to remember. Remote monitoring Guesty Locks Manager will monitor and report on the health of your locks, giving you peace of mind that you’re delivering a great guest experience. Automatic deactivation Locks will be deactivated at the designated guest check-out time, ensuring the safety of your properties and integrity of your reservations. Control property entry Monitor guest, staff, and vendor access to all of your properties with unique, trackable codes and easy access to a full activity log Even more in your locks dashboard Full activity log Track all door activity on supported devices with time-stamped logs for complete transparency, security and access verification. Lock health manager Monitor all your locks in real-time, tracking battery levels, Wi-Fi connectivity, and performance all from one view. Remote lock and unlock Control your property's security from anywhere with the ability to lock and unlock doors remotely through Guesty's platform. Quick-access reservation display See guest and reservation details side-by-side enabling quick and accurate response without having to toggle" Unlocking 5-star reviews Mike Z Rentals Florida | United States "Smart locks helped the guest experience tremendously. Guests feel secure with their own unique code — and it’s all managed through Guesty." Travli Arizona | United States "Having everything in one platform makes it extremely easy, plus the peace of mind knowing the codes are provided is a game changer." FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Here is what some of our customers needed to know before signing up what is a smart lock management system? Smart lock management software connects a property's keyless entry devices to one system that can generate access codes, track lock activity, and control entry remotely, instead of requiring a separate app for every lock brand installed across a portfolio. Guesty Locks Manager is the smart lock management layer built into Guesty's vacation rental platform: it connects to 40+ smart lock brands — including Schlage, Nuki, and TTLock — from a single dashboard, so property managers can generate, monitor, and revoke access without leaving the same system they use to run bookings. What if I don’t have a smart lock? Smart locks are beneficial for everyone as they provide more convenient and secure access to your property. Read more about why using smart locks is a best practice and how combining them with management software can improve operational efficiency and guest satisfaction. Which smart lock brands does Guesty support? Guesty supports over 40 brands of smart lock providers. You can find the full list here! How do I set up my locks? Setting up your locks within Guesty is easy. Simply connect your locks provider to the Guesty platform and link your locks to the matching Guesty property. You'll be all ready to share access codes with your guests! how to automate access codes for Airbnb guests? Guesty Locks Manager automates the full lifecycle of a guest's door code. When a reservation is confirmed, the system generates a unique access code automatically — no manual entry required — and that same code works across every lock the guest needs, from the front gate to the unit door, so there's nothing for the guest to remember. When the stay ends, Guesty deactivates the code automatically at the scheduled check-out time, so managers never have to remember to revoke access or worry about a past guest re-entering the property.
